5 تطلّبهُ He sought it, or demanded it, repeatedly, or time after time: (S, O:) [he made repeated, or successive, endeavours to obtain it, or to attain it: he prosecuted a search after it:] or he sought it diligently, studiously, sedulously, or earnestly; syn. اِبْتَغَاهُ: (Msb:) or he sought, desired, or endeavoured, leisurely, to find it and to get or take it; (O, TA;) and (TA) so ↓ طلّبهُ , inf. n. تَطْلِيبٌ; (K, TA;) and ↓ طَلَبَهُ ; (TA;) from [various] places. (O, TA.) ―
-b2- See also 1, first sentence.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
